findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.75 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #d4622f, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
findings.note: The low color contrast ratio of 3.75:1 makes the button text difficult to read for users with low vision.
findings.suggested_fix: Darken the background color of the button until the contrast ratio against the white text reaches at least 4.5:1.

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.47:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #ffffff, surrounding text: #cfd6d9)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
findings.note: The link is indistinguishable from the surrounding text, which creates confusion for users with low vision or color blindness when trying to identify interactive elements.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an underline to the link text and ensure the link color maintains at least a 3:1 contrast ratio against the surrounding text.
